name: BSP_SizedStoragePool_GetSingleton
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet app_init_alloc_string_helpers, assembly-verified; drops the _Provisional suffix, behaviour now established. Takes no arguments and returns the string pool pointer in EAX (RET, no stack cleanup): callers push the arguments of the FOLLOWING thiscall before calling it, which is why the decompiler shows phantom parameters at 0041dd64 and 0041ddc9. Lazy singleton behind DAT_01090aa8 under EnterCriticalSection/LeaveCriticalSection ([00ce2218]/[00ce2210]) with an SEH frame; on first use it allocates 0x8ad4a0 bytes through 00bf681b, constructs with 00bd1480 and registers teardown through 00415350/00bd0c30. Object: vtable +0, 7,000,000-byte bump arena +8, bump offset +0x6acfc8, free ring +0x6acfcc, lock +0x8ad484. 2857 callers. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_ALLOC_STRINGS.md.

name: BSP_CriticalSection_DestroyOwned
evidence: ECX points to lock pointer. Drains positive depth at +18h via LeaveCriticalSection; DeleteCriticalSection then free, followed by owner-pointer clear at 0041ccb6. Shutdown requires owning/quiescent thread. Pointer-clear bytes were undefined under the old free noreturn annotation.

name: BSP_NativeString_Resize
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet app_init_alloc_string_helpers, assembly-verified. __thiscall, ECX 8-byte string {uint length +0, char* data +4}, stack (uint length, char preserve), RET 8. No capacity field, no small-buffer area: the block is always length+1 bytes, so a shrink reallocates. A request for the length already held returns immediately even when data is null (0041dd4a). Length 0 releases data with old_length+1 and clears both fields. Otherwise it allocates length+1 from the string pool (00419cc0 then 00bd1120) BEFORE releasing the old block, optionally copies min(old,new) bytes, releases the old block with old_length+1, then stores data/length and writes the terminator at data[length]. 2280 callers. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_ALLOC_STRINGS.md.

name: BSP_NativeString_AssignCString
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. thiscall(this, const char*), returns this. Null source assigns length 0. Calls BSP_NativeString_Resize(len, preserve=0) then copies exactly length bytes, so unlike the construct-from-C-string helper 0041e870 it does not copy the terminator. Assignment used for the resolved language name at 008f808b and 008f8175. docs/WINMAIN_STARTUP.md

name: BSP_NativeString_Assign
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet app_init_alloc_string_helpers, assembly-verified. __thiscall, ECX 8-byte string, stack (const char* text), RET 4, returns this in EAX. This is a CONSTRUCTOR body, not an assignment: 0041e87a zeroes length and data before doing anything, so calling it on a live string abandons that buffer. strlen inline, then BSP_NativeString_Resize(len, preserve=1), then, only if data is non-null, memcpy of len+1 bytes, which rewrites the terminator Resize already placed. An empty text leaves data null because Resize(0) from length 0 is a no-op. 1230 callers. The name is kept for continuity with docs/APP_INITIALIZE_MAP.md; BSP_NativeString_ConstructFromCString would describe it better. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_ALLOC_STRINGS.md.
